## Checklist

- [ ] The page uses the template and carries the metadata block (release, components, deployment method, status, risk).
- [ ] `status` is `draft` for a new page (someone else will validate it), or a confirmation is added to an existing page.
- [ ] Every state-changing command has a ⚠️ warning; every destructive command has a 🛑 warning with what can be lost and what to check first.
- [ ] The *Validity and limits* section says where this was observed and what was not tested.
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames, domains, IP or MAC addresses, customer, employer or person names; logs are redacted.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
